structured.answer: Hold the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracking fund (5139282) in a Pesagot account: the page puts it at 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, after fees and tax, in today's money. Choosing the broker matters up to ~23k ₪ and choosing the fund only up to ~4.5k ₪, so the fund pick is nearly irrelevant.
